t_advice_summary_textbox.text: When picking a gnome, keep in mind how many mushrooms you get because if it stays high for a few rounds, keep choosing that gnome, but if the points get lower, choose the other gnome that is available so you can try to get as many points as possible.

vb_textbox.text: When you pick a mushroom, remember how many points you get. If the points are high, keep picking the same mushroom, but choose the other mushroom once the points start lowering. The key is consistency, meaning the points might stay similar for a few rounds if you pick the same mushroom. Obviously, it can change after a few rounds. Overall, it is up to your judgment.
